items.title: A $1.5 Billion Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAdelante Capital Management, which manages $1. 49 billion, added to Vivmark Residential (VMRK:NYSE), Realty Income (O:NYSE) and Ryman Hospitality Properties (RHP:NYSE) in the Q3, its latest 13F shows.

items.title: Forget Being a Landlord: These 3 REITs Pay You to Own Apartments
items.summary: Apartment REITs are legally required to hand most of their income straight to shareholders, but not all of them are equally safe bets right now. Three landlords are collecting rent checks while new construction dries up, and the differences between them could cost you real money.

items.title: Multibillion Dollar Opportunity in Maturing Real Estate Debt: Global Asset Management CEO Richard Balles, Live at Nasdaq

items.title: Three Megamergers Closed This Year, and $120,000 Across the Combined Companies Pays $5,050 a Year
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark swallowed Kenvue, Public Storage absorbed National Storage Affiliates, and two apartment REITs fused into one. Now each board decides what shareholders get paid, and the integration costs, debt loads, and dilution warnings tell very different stories.

items.title: Renters Are Staying Put. These 4 Apartment REITs Could Benefit
items.summary: Fewer renters are buying homes, and apartment landlords are quietly collecting the payoff. We checked four REIT dividends against their cash flow, and the one paying the most has the thinnest safety margin. Two coastal giants didn't make the cut.

items.title: Vivmark Residential (VMRK) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.summary: Management raised synergy targets and plans to double development activity.

items.title: Vivmark finds additional efficiencies after completing AVB-EQR merger
items.summary: The REIT’s net run-rate operating synergies increased by $10 million to $135 million, driven by increased portfolio net operating income opportunities, according to its Q3 earnings release.

items.title: Vivmark (VMRK) Tops Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Vivmark (VMRK) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +6.19% and +1.00%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
